limitations: No Copilot licence, review-enabled repository or Actions-enabled target was available, so no Copilot review was executed; every quantitative statement in the article is GitHub's documented estimate and the article says so.

GitHub Docs is rendered HTML; the text twins are tag-stripped captures taken 2026-10-30T15:27:50Z, so navigation text remains in the saved files. Excerpts are exact substrings of those captures, not of GitHub's markdown source.
The pages are living documents: prices, plan names and preview labels can change after the last source clock reading in this run (2026-10-30T15:27:50.888462+00:00).

The round-1 draft bytes were not preserved in this tree, so the claim that only the two corrected statements and the changelog changed rests on the correction record and the changelog rather than a byte diff. Every carried-forward claim was instead re-asserted against the current draft and re-matched to a fresh capture.
The pre-refresh repository history is flattened, so the original publication date rests on the frontmatter date of the pre-refresh revision rather than an independent publish record.

The statement that GitHub does not label a degraded review is supported only by the absence of such a sentence in the concepts page; absence of evidence in one page is not proof across all GitHub documentation.

Bing demand evidence (13 -> 3 clicks, 221 -> 171 impressions for the weeks ending 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-23) is an aggregate top-100 weekly export, too sparse to attribute a CTR change to the title or description; this review makes no causality claim about it.
